- Explicit page: 12240 × 15840 twips (Letter); left/right 1800, top/bottom 1440
- Orientation is the specified portrait default; gutter is the specified zero default
- DOP: Table stream offset 433, 500 bytes; no facing/mirror/top-gutter/two-on-one modes
